title: NASA Sun fact sheet: GM 132,712.
summary: The Sun fact sheet lists GM as 132,712.
body: NASA's Sun fact sheet lists GM (x 10 6 km 3 /s 2 ) as 132,712. for the Sun. A bulk-parameter cell. The sheet does not label this cell as a model. Mass, volumetric mean radius, luminosity, spectral type, and the sidereal rotation period are on other cards and are not repeated as the claim here. Last Updated line: 9 May 2024.
